 Chad Lowe’s daughter Mabel celebrates sister Fiona’s 14th birthday after her tragic death: ‘I miss you’ 
 By 
 Nicki Gostin 
 Published 
 Nov. 15, 2026, 2:21 p.m. ET 
 See more of our coverage in your search results. 
 Make Page Six a Preferred Source 
 Chad Lowe’s oldest daughter, Mabel Lowe, honored her late sister Fiona’s 14th birthday on social media.
 On her Instagram Stories, the 17-year-old shared a sweet photo of Fiona holding a Severus Snape poster from “Harry Potter.”
 “Happy birthday fiona,” she wrote over the pic, “….i miss you.”

 Mabel also posted three more photos of the two of them together, writing over one, “…. “♏+♉forever.”
 Fiona died by suicide on Sept. 29, with her family, parents Chad Lowe and Kim Painter, and sisters, Mabel and Nixie, 10, telling Page Six they were “deeply heartbroken” by the loss.
 “She was adored by her sisters and she was deeply loved by her parents,” the family continued. “In fact, she was the light of our lives. Her passing is devastating for our entire family and we ask for prayers and privacy at this time.”
 6 
 Mabel Lowe also posted a sweet photo of the siblings wearing cowboy hats. mabellowe_/instagram 
 6 
 Fiona, the middle child of Chad Lowe and Kim Painter, died by suicide in September. Instagram/ichadlowe 
 Following Fiona’s death, Mabel shared an emotional Instagram post about her late sibling.
 “I love you so much fiona ❤️ i wish your short time here was easier and i hope your mind is at ease now,” she penned. “I will honor you forever and keep your memory alive. I love you, i hope you knew just how much.”
 Last month, the family held a private celebration of life service , kept to family and close friends.

 The clan’s first public appearance came days after Fiona’s death at Rob Lowe’s son Matthew’s star-studded wedding on Oct. 10.
 Chad is Rob’s younger brother.
 The family home was quickly put up for sale , less than three weeks after Fiona’s death.
